newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Celsius shares up on product potential.
newsitem.headline: Celsius shares up on product potential.

text.p: Shares in Swedish defense company Celsius AB rose on Thursday on hopes that a new flight surveillance system will open up a billion crown market.
At 1410 GMT, the share was up almost seven percent at 102 crowns, outperforming a general index rise of 1.11 percent.

Celsius Tech, a unit of Celsius, and Saab Dynamics, a unit of Investor AB own the new system for air and sea traffic and they said on Thursday that it will take two or three years before sales of the system will take off.
The system was highlighted by a Thursday newspaper article.
"The share is moving on the newspaper article," a trader said. "It's nothing new that the system has potential on the civilian side, but the article made it come in focus."
